description: Test suite for Draft Store functionalities in Mattermost, including saving, updating, deleting drafts, and handling drafts associated with posts.

methods.name: testSaveDraft
methods.description: Tests saving new drafts and retrieving them for a user.

methods.name: testUpdateDraft
methods.description: Tests updating an existing draft and verifying the changes.

methods.name: testDeleteDraft
methods.description: Tests deleting drafts and ensuring they are no longer retrievable.

methods.name: testPermanentDeleteDraftsByUser
methods.description: Tests permanent deletion of all drafts for a specific user.

methods.name: testGetDraft
methods.description: Tests retrieving specific drafts by user and channel.

methods.name: testGetDraftsForUser
methods.description: Tests retrieving all drafts for a user, including handling null types.

methods.name: testGetLastCreateAtAndUserIDValuesForEmptyDraftsMigration
methods.description: Tests pagination and retrieval of last create time and user ID for migration.

methods.name: testDeleteEmptyDraftsByCreateAtAndUserID
methods.description: Tests deletion of empty drafts in pages, including edge cases.

methods.name: testDeleteOrphanDraftsByCreateAtAndUserID
methods.description: Tests deletion of orphan drafts linked to posts, including various post states.

methods.name: testDeleteDraftsAssociatedWithPost
methods.description: Tests deletion of drafts associated with specific posts.
